lowTriage.description:
ProgrammableExactHookemonReusablePlanModuleV2.validatePermitV2(IProgrammableExactHookemonReusableNormalCreateProfileV2.ExactHookemonReusablePlanV2,IProgrammableExactHookemonReusableNormalCreateProfileV2.PermitTransportV2,IProgrammableExactHookemonReusableNormalCreateProfileV2.PlanCommitmentsV2,bytes,ProgrammableExactHookemonReusablePlanModuleV2.PermitValidationContextV2) (src/router_vnext/ProgrammableExactHookemonReusablePlanModuleV2.sol#272-327) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- permit.releaseBindingHash != context.permitAuthority.computeReleaseBindingHash(transport.releaseBinding) || permit.generationBindingHash != context.permitAuthority.computeGenerationBindingHash(permit) || transport.kernelEnvelope.kernelGrantDigest != context.grantDigest || transport.kernelEnvelope.reviewerCurrentnessDigest != context.currentnessDigest || transport.kernelEnvelope.applicantWalletIntentDigest != context.walletIntentDigest || permit.kernelExecutionEnvelopeHash != context.permitAuthority.computeKernelExecutionEnvelopeHash(transport.kernelEnvelope) || permit.executionValue != 0 || permit.deadline <= block.timestamp || transport.permitSignature.length == 0 || context.grantDigest == bytes32(0) || context.currentnessDigest == bytes32(0) || context.walletIntentDigest == bytes32(0) (src/router_vnext/ProgrammableExactHookemonReusablePlanModuleV2.sol#304-313)
lowTriage.rationale: The comparison rejects expired short-lived permits. The frozen shared Verifier independently enforces the signed notBefore/deadline window during consumption.

lowTriage.description:
ProgrammableHookemonLaunchRegistryV1._grantRole(bytes32,address) (src/router_vnext/ProgrammableHookemonLaunchRegistryV1.sol#359-364) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- role == WRITER_ROLE && LAUNCH_ROUTE != address(0) && account != LAUNCH_ROUTE (src/router_vnext/ProgrammableHookemonLaunchRegistryV1.sol#360)
lowTriage.rationale: The detector misclassifies role/address equality as timestamp logic; the function reads no timestamp and only rejects WRITER_ROLE grants to accounts other than immutable LAUNCH_ROUTE.

securitySemantics.approvalCancellation: Canonical repository key plus approval generation; approvalId cannot narrow revocation.
securitySemantics.postconditions: Architecture, canonical pool, custody/holder ownership, locked position, empty approvals, 29,000/1,000 inclusive fee split, Programmable fee owner, and no unexpected balances are re-read after deployment.
securitySemantics.registryWriter: Immutable LAUNCH_ROUTE is the only WRITER_ROLE account; every other grant is rejected.
securitySemantics.release: Exact Authority, Registry, Profile, route, runtime hashes, profile binding, execution authority and REQUIRED Kernel envelope.
securitySemantics.repositoryOnce: Permanent shared Authority repository consumption survives signer and release rotation and blocks every later route.
securitySemantics.rollback: Any deployment, postcondition, Registry or Kernel finalization revert rolls back Authority consumption, Registry record and every new contract.
